name: Crossing of two iMA
summary: This EA implements a classic dual moving average crossover strategy, generating buy signals when a fast moving average crosses above a slow moving average and sell signals when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. It uses the built-in iMA indicator of MQL5 for both moving average calculations. Trades are opened on crossover signals with configurable lot size, stop loss, and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了经典的双均线交叉策略，当快速均线向上穿越慢速均线时产生买入信号，当快速均线向下穿越慢速均线时产生卖出信号。它使用MQL5内置的iMA指标进行均线计算，在交叉信号出现时按照配置的手数、止损和止盈水平开仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双均线交叉的趋势跟踪策略，核心概念是利用两条不同周期的移动平均线的交叉来判断趋势方向的变化。入场条件为：快速均线从下方穿越慢速均线时做多，快速均线从上方穿越慢速均线时做空，这本质上是一个趋势反转信号。出场条件依赖于固定的止损和止盈参数，当价格触及预设的止损或止盈水平时平仓，此外如果出现反向交叉信号也可能触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，由参数Lots指定每笔交易的手数，没有根据账户资金动态调整的机制。资金管理方面较为简单，仅依赖止损止盈比例来控制每笔交易的风险收益比，缺少账户级别的风险控制如最大回撤限制或仓位比例计算。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为基础，属于典型的趋势跟踪入门级策略。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual moving average crossover trend-following strategy, where the core concept is using the intersection of two moving averages with different periods to detect trend direction changes. Entry conditions are straightforward: a buy signal is generated when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA, and a sell signal is triggered when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA, which essentially captures trend reversal moments. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit parameters, closing positions when price hits the preset SL or TP levels, and reverse crossover signals may also trigger position closure. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size specified by the Lots parameter, with no dynamic adjustment mechanism based on account equity or balance. Money management is relatively simplistic, relying solely on the stop loss to take profit ratio to control the risk-reward profile of each trade, lacking account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or percentage-based position sizing. The overall strategy logic is clear but basic, representing a typical entry-level trend-following approach.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证，适合初学者学习和改进
使用MQL5内置iMA指标句柄，计算效率高且与平台标准一致
具有可配置的止损和止盈参数，提供了基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and verify, suitable for beginners to learn from and improve
Uses MQL5 built-in iMA indicator handles for efficient calculation consistent with platform standards
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 固定手数交易无法根据账户规模和波动性动态调整仓位，资金管理粗放
均线交叉策略在震荡行情中会产生大量虚假信号导致频繁亏损
缺少新K线检测机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓造成冗余交易
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing cannot dynamically adjust position size based on account size and volatility, making money management crude
MA crossover strategies generate numerous false signals in ranging/choppy markets leading to frequent losses
Lacks new bar detection mechanism, potentially opening redundant trades on the same bar
improvements: 增加新K线检测逻辑，确保每个交叉信号只触发一次交易，避免重复开仓
加入ATR动态止损和仓位计算，根据市场波动性自适应调整风险参数
improvements_en: Add new bar detection logic to ensure each crossover signal triggers only one trade, avoiding redundant entries
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss and position sizing to adaptively adjust risk parameters based on market volatility

risk_points: 缺少新K线检测可能导致同一信号重复开仓，增加不必要风险敞口
震荡行情中频繁虚假信号可能导致连续止损累积亏损
固定手数不随账户余额调整，大亏损后可能无法承受后续交易
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar detection may cause repeated entries on the same signal, increasing unnecessary risk exposure
Frequent false signals in ranging markets may lead to consecutive stop losses and accumulated losses
Fixed lot size does not adjust with account balance, potentially unable to sustain trading after significant drawdown
